minutes.headline: Select Board tabled paying the two school bus companies for service not rendered, 4-1; also split on committee seats.
minutes.summary: The board heard the school business manager and superintendent on a request to pay the two bus vendors part of the contract for the spring closure. After long debate over charity, precedent and state-aid risk, the board tabled it for more information. The board also made a statement on Memorial Day cemetery conditions, covered House Bill 4820 on mail voting, made committee appointments (which turned contentious over the TC Passios design committee seat), and heard the town manager's report.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-1 to table a request to pay the two school bus companies for service not rendered during the spring closure.
School staff are to bring back more information on the bus payment, and the vendors were asked to make their case.
The board appointed a member to the TC Passios building design committee, with one no vote; the seat had been disputed.
The board ratified the town manager's beach coordinator and seasonal lifeguard appointments, 5-0 by roll call.
The town manager reported a health insurance premium holiday, with savings to be reserved for the fall special town meeting.

why_it_matters: The bus payment would pay vendors for service not delivered, and whether it comes from the school budget or elsewhere bears on school spending and, through state aid, on local taxes.
The reserved insurance savings and the sale proceeds from West Street properties may shape what residents are asked to vote on at the fall special town meeting.
watch_next: The bus payment request returning to the Select Board after school staff provide more information.
Goals for the board, which were to go on the next meeting agenda or the 21st.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the beach appointment ratification, the 4-1 vote to table the bus payments, and most figures. They differ on the TCP committee appointment, the cemetery representative, and several items only one record has. The main point to check is the TCP Building Design Committee vote, where the appointee (Dwyer or Jeffreys) and the vote split differ.
